This small plot of beans is mine, and I plant it like my father showed me. I do not have money to buy the fertilizer from the bag — that one is for the maize people, not for beans. The beans, they make their own strength in the soil, so I just put the small manure from my goats and chickens before the rains come. I keep the seeds from last year's harvest like always, and my wife and the children will help me weed when the rains start.
